site.description: Halden Studio designs and builds calm, motion-led websites for studios and small companies.

work.p_1: Selected websites, from first sketch to launch.
work.p_7: A web shop for a small seaweed skincare brand, built around ingredients and slow storytelling.
work.p_8: Product pages load in under a second, and wholesale requests reach the right person.

services.p_1: Strategy, design and code from one desk.
services.p_8: Transitions and small interactions that guide the eye and give a site its rhythm.
services.blockquote_17: Iris asked better questions about our customers than we did. The shop finally sounds like us, and wholesale requests arrive sorted.
services.blockquote_19: Clear plan, no surprises, and every change was explained before it happened. The booking flow is half as long as before.
services.blockquote_21: Our older patients book online now. That alone was worth it, and the site looks calm instead of clinical.
services.figcaption_22_html: Hannah Weiss · Practice manager, Mosaic Clinic
services.blockquote_23: She let the photographs do the talking and made the motion feel like turning pages. Clients mention it in first meetings.
services.blockquote_25: Fast, honest and calm under deadline pressure. Volunteer sign-ups never dropped a single message.

about.p_1: A studio of one, with a few clients at a time.
about.p_4: I design and build websites for studios and small companies: calm layouts, motion with a reason, and a contact form that never loses a message.

contact.p_1: Tell me about the project. I reply within two working days.
contact.p_17_html: Thanks, there. Your message is in my inbox. I reply within two working days.
